html2canvas-pro 2.5.0 (MIT), https://github.com/yorickshan/html2canvas-pro
A maintained fork of html2canvas with the same API that also parses oklch(), oklab(), lab(), lch(), color() and color-mix(),
which Unraid 7's component CSS (Tailwind 4) produces; html2canvas 1.4.1 throws "unsupported color function" on those.
Source: npm tarball html2canvas-pro-2.5.0.tgz, integrity sha512-+xuLQWcYMGvbXtlIzVOLvNJEXqL/dY7Dbn2T4qYtJvqfPVtJ8BcNr1CrrUp/uCxne9DE/F+eZHsf1khb1dbMyg== (verified)
File: package/dist/html2canvas-pro.min.js (unmodified), licence: package/LICENSE
Replaces html2canvas 1.4.1 (niklasvh, MIT).
